title: SPOT: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.04419v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but standard reverse-KL training can assign insufficient probability to other plausible continuations. Teacher entropy alone does not reveal whether uncertainty is concentrated among a few plausible next tokens or dispersed over a long probability tail, nor whether the student already represents those candidates well. Moreover, local teacher probabilities may not predict downstream success. We introduce Sparse Probing and Outcome-calibrated Targets OPD (SPOT), which addresses two coupled decisions, where to probe and what to distill, through an acquisition--exploration--exploitation procedure. During acquisition, a position-level score combines normalized teacher entropy, the probability mass captured by a small top-$k$ candidate set, and student--teacher mismatch to allocate a limited probing budget. translated_title: SPOT：面向在线策略蒸馏的稀疏探测与结果校准
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在由学生生成的轨迹上提供密集的教师监督，但标准的反向KL训练可能为其他合理的延续分配不足的概率。仅靠教师熵无法揭示不确定性是集中在少数几个合理的下一个令牌上，还是分散在长概率尾部，也无法判断学生是否已经很好地代表了这些候选。此外，局部教师概率可能无法预测下游成功。我们引入了稀疏探测与结果校准目标OPD（SPOT），它通过一个获取-探索-利用过程来解决两个耦合的决策：在哪里探测以及蒸馏什么。在获取阶段，一个位置级评分结合了归一化教师熵、由小型top-k候选集捕获的概率质量以及学生-教师不匹配度，以分配有限的探测预算。在探索阶段，SPOT评估...
tldr: SPOT通过稀疏探测与结果校准机制，解决了在线策略蒸馏中教师不确定性分布和学生候选表示不足的问题，并利用获取-探索-利用策略优化了探测位置和蒸馏目标。
en_tdlr: SPOT addresses the coupled decisions of where to probe and what to distill in on-policy distillation via sparse probing and outcome calibration, using an acquisition-exploration-exploitation procedure to optimize limited probing budgets and improve downstream performance.
